title: Frontend: Star Rating
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Star Rating. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({initial=0,readOnly=false}). Render five radio buttons[data-rating=1..5] in a radiogroup, with aria-checked. Click commits rating; ArrowRight/Left clamps between 1 and 5. Output rating in [data-testid=rating]. Read-only mode ignores changes. No hover-only selection is committed.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Store the committed rating and transient preview independently.
alternativeApproaches: Support fractional display without pretending half-star selection follows automatically from integer radios.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Unrated; hover without commit; pointer leave.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
